name: Plant Diversity Index
calculation_method: Shannon-Wiener diversity index calculated across 1-hectare permanent forest plots, normalized to regional tropical evergreen climax benchmarks.
interpretation: High native woody endemism preserved in core zones, but understory flora exhibits early signs of edge-effect desiccation.

name: Habitat Connectivity Index
calculation_method: Least-cost path raster resistance modeling and Morphological Spatial Pattern Analysis (MSPA) assessing structural corridor continuity.
interpretation: Substantial fragmentation caused by linear highway corridors and tea plantation concessions, severing arboreal mammal travel.

name: Pollinator Network Robustness
calculation_method: Bipartite plant-pollinator modularity, nestedness ratio, and high-canopy bee visitation frequency.
interpretation: Moderate nesting density for Apis dorsata; lower than historical averages due to peripheral agrochemical drift.

name: Bird Network & Seed Dispersal
calculation_method: Frugivore abundance index, hollow tree availability metric, and observed seed dispersal shadow distances.
interpretation: Strong Great Hornbill frugivory activity maintains large-seeded canopy recruitment in continuous patches.

name: Keystone Stability Index
calculation_method: Combined density index of keystone primates, carnivore territory overlap, and mast flowering tree recruitment rate.
interpretation: Endangered Lion-tailed macaque populations are restricted to isolated canopy pockets, elevating inbreeding risk.

name: Plant Diversity Index
calculation_method: Mangrove floral composition ratio, freshwater-loving Heritiera fomes presence against hyper-saline Avicennia pioneers.
interpretation: Sundari tree stands suffer severe dieback disease (top-dying) driven by escalating salinity and reduced upstream sweet-water flow.

name: Habitat Connectivity Index
calculation_method: Inter-island tidal channel hydrodynamic continuity and mudflat corridor width evaluated across tidal cycles.
interpretation: Aquatic connectivity remains resilient across main channels, but siltation isolates secondary creeks during low spring tides.

name: Pollinator Network Robustness
calculation_method: Mangrove flower honeybee colonization density and nectar forage availability index across salt marshes.
interpretation: Severely depressed honeybee colony densities following repeated cyclone landfalls and high nest mortality.

name: Bird Network & Seed Dispersal
calculation_method: Piscivore and raptor nesting frequency, tidal feeding territoriality, and mudflat foraging transects.
interpretation: White-bellied sea eagles maintain stable eyries, but ground-foraging kingfishers and waders suffer from shrimp pond disturbance.

name: Benthic/Aquatic Health Index
calculation_method: Mud crab carapace biometric distributions, penaeid prawn recruitment rates, and estuarine trophic cascade analysis.
interpretation: Over-exploitation of wild tiger prawn seed nets captures excessive non-target benthic larvae, depressing benthic recruitment.
